docs.title: 求职工作台
docs.text:
一个本地优先、AI 可审计的求职工作台：从 JD 解析到 offer 决策的完整链路，用纯 Markdown 与 CSV 管理在你自己的磁盘上——可以从桌面端、浏览器或你自己的 AI CLI 三种入口驱动。

当前版本：26.10.0

docs.title: 功能一览
docs.text:
• 四个 AI 工作流：jwb-jd（JD 解析评分）、jwb-apply（投递包）、jwb-track（追踪看板）、jwb-resume（PDF 重建校验），由仓库内 jobws CLI 驱动——命令速查见使用手册。
  • Web 界面：八个页面（看板 / 追踪表 / 岗位池 / 简历工坊 / 准备 / 进展 / 素材库 / 设置）与 CLI 共享同一份数据；简历一键导入是抽取而非生成，AI 改写须过五项本地反编造校验；版式与强调色自由组合，生成的 PDF 全部单栏过 ATS 校验。
  • 投递之后的闭环：面试记录一键导出 .ics、联系人跟进提醒、Offer 并排对比（只并排事实，绝不给建议）、版本谱系、周期复盘、失败聚类、投递健康度四态——每条都给出可人工核对的具体理由，而不是一个黑箱分数。
  • 只读邮箱拉取（可选）：用你自己的 IMAP 授权码拉取最近的招聘邮件，转成逐条状态建议——只读连接、只在点击时连接、凭证只存本地；邮件永不自动改阶段，一律由你确认。
  • 评分框架：资格门槛前置（学历 → 专业 → 届数 → 外语 → 城市），四维度加权五档位；档案没填的岗位判「待补档案」——不打分、不终止、不猜测，补齐即可评。
  • 领域插件是数据，不是代码：内置暖通制冷与软件后端两个示例；换专业只要照领域插件合同写一份纯数据插件，jobws lint domains 自动校验结构。

docs.title: 界面预览
docs.text: 以下为中文界面截图，均为 demo 数据（jobws init --target demo --demo，公司、岗位、人名为占位）；英文界面是同样的页面换界面文字，见英文版首页。

docs.title: 快速开始
docs.text:
# 1. 初始化工作区：--domain 换成你专业的插件；只想先看看界面可加 --demo
python tools/jobws.py init --target personal --domain hvac-cooling
# 2. 分发技能 / 命令 / 子代理到你的 AI CLI（CodeBuddy / Claude Code / ~/.agents/skills/）
python tools/jobws.py skills install --target user
# 3. 填好 personal/AGENTS.md 的硬门槛事实，再对 AI CLI 说「解析这份 JD」

命令行只需 Python 3.12+（标准库）；PDF 生成需要 Chrome 或 Edge。不想配环境？下载页提供免 Python / Node 的桌面版安装包。

docs.title: 推广说明
docs.text: AI 功能是 BYOK：自带任意 OpenAI 兼容服务商的 key 即可。还没有 key 的话，设置页把 OrcaRouter 预置为可选 Provider。如实说明：这是一个推广（返佣）链接——通过它注册会给本项目作者返佣；你的价格与权益不受影响，点击也只是打开网页（本应用不会因点击发出任何数据）。

docs.title: 下载
docs.text:
最新版本：26.10.0（2026-10-06 发布）

English: Download

docs.title: 主通道：GitHub Releases
docs.text:
下载 Windows 安装包（直达）

链接指向的文件就是 job-workbench-setup-26.10.0-win64.exe——Windows x64 安装包，向导式安装，免 Python / Node 环境。如果直达链接打不开（版本刚发布、CDN 未同步），可打开发布页在 Assets 区选取。

国内网络访问 GitHub 可能不畅。如果发布页打不开、或下载中途断流，请走下面的备用通道。

docs.title: 备用通道（国内网络）
docs.text:
在 Gitee 镜像仓库的 Issues 留言（写清需要的版本号）——Gitee 国内可直达，不必先打开 GitHub；我们会回复一个当时的备用下载链接。（GitHub 能直连时也可以用主仓库 Issues。）

如实说明：安装包 130+ MB，超过 Gitee 附件的 100 MB 上限，所以备用通道只能提供链接（网盘等），不能在 Gitee 上直接挂附件；备用链接由人工维护，可能滞后于正式 Releases。能直连 GitHub 时请优先使用主通道。

docs.title: 未签名说明（SmartScreen）
docs.text:
安装包尚未做代码签名。首次运行时 Windows 可能显示「Windows 已保护你的电脑」——这是未签名软件的正常提示：点「更多信息」→「仍要运行」。

SmartScreen 信誉按版本重新积累，后续版本升级后可能再次提示；签名的缺位不影响自动更新（完整性以 latest.yml 里的哈希为准）。

docs.title: 校验下载完整性
docs.text:
自 v26.9.0 起，每个 Release 附 SHA256SUMS.txt（安装包与 latest.yml 的 SHA256 哈希）。下载完成后，在 PowerShell 或 CMD 里执行（文件名换成你实际下载的那个）：

certutil -hashfile job-workbench-setup-26.10.0-win64.exe SHA256

把输出与 Release 页 SHA256SUMS.txt 中同名文件的哈希对照：一致说明文件完好、与发布者上传的一致。如实说明：这证明的是完整性；未签名场景下，它不构成发布者身份认证。

docs.title: 毕业条件、支持策略与数据兼容承诺
docs.text:
这份文档回答三个「用户会问、而仓库以前只在散文里顺带提过」的问题：

  1. 什么时候算正式版（毕业条件）
  2. 什么环境被支持（支持策略）
  3. 我的数据会不会因为升级打不开（数据兼容承诺）

相关决策留档：decisions/ship-once-per-release.md（单一发布节点与月粒度 CalVer 版本）、decisions/read-missing-columns-as-empty.md（兼容条款的技术实现）、decisions/keep-writes-human-confirmed.md（写入边界）。

docs.title: 一、毕业条件（首个正式发布即 1.0-equivalent）
docs.text:
毕业不是「功能攒够了」，而是可判据的稳定。四条全部满足才算毕业：

# 判据 怎么核 1 连续 14 天自用无阻断缺陷 期间每天至少走一遍真实流程（看板 → 投递 → 邮件/面试记录 → 简历或题库），出现「必须绕过或改数据才能继续」的问题即重新计时 2 主流程冒烟全过 八页 + 命令行主流程（init / track / jd / apply / resume / export）在同一版本上跑通；CI 全部 job 绿（后端 / MCP / 前端 / UI 冒烟 / 安装冒烟 / exe 冒烟 / PR 标题） 3 无未决阻断问题 没有挂着未修的 P0 / MAJOR 级审查发现；已知边界写进文档而不是留在 issue 里 4 兼容条款生效 下面第三节的四条在最近一次升级里被真实验证过（旧工作区直接打开、无需迁移）

毕业判定（2026-10-09）：四条全部满足——① 连续 14 天自用无阻断（dev 栈，2026-09-26 起）； ② 主流程冒烟全绿（八页 + 命令行 + CI 全 job，同一版本 26.10.0）；③ 无未决 P0/MAJOR； ④ 兼容条款经 26.10.0 升级真机复装（真下载 → 安装 → 打开旧工作区）验证。判定证据归档在 releases/26.10.0-verification.md。

未满足时的诚实说法：版本仍是「自用可用」，不是「正式版」——本仓库不靠把版本号写成 1.0 来暗示稳定。

docs.title: 二、支持策略（按版本与日期表述）
docs.text:
维度 支持范围 发布版本 只支持最近一次发布（与 ../SECURITY.md 同口径：修复只落在最新版；更早的版本请先升级再报问题） 运行环境（命令行 / 后端） Python 3.12（验证基线，<3.12 会被自检拦下）；标准库为主；pypdf（PDF 校验）与 certifi（出网证书兜底）随后端依赖声明安装，缺失时对应能力降级并给出可读错误；PDF 生成需本机 Chrome 或 Edge 桌面端 Windows 安装包（主目标平台；真机冒烟后才发布，正式包复装见 release-checklist.md 的「发布后完整验证链」）；其他平台未验证，不承诺 AI 宿主 CodeBuddy、Claude Code（.codebuddy/、.claude/ 落点）；跨运行时 ~/.agents/skills/；MCP 宿主（Gemini CLI、Codex、VS Code 等）按 mcp-integration.md 配置；DSH（DeepSeek Harness）走插件包 dsh-job-workbench——宿主版本用 peer 声明参与准入（越界即组合包跳过；官方 compatibility.json 可豁免），兼容区间与放宽路径见 ../integrations/dsh/README.md §七 数据位置 全部本地：工作区在你的目录里（新装默认 <系统用户数据目录>/job-workbench/data，详见下文「升级路径 · 数据位置」）；凭证在系统安全存储（Windows 凭据管理器，工作区 config/ 只留引用）；无项目方云端、无遥测。联网只发生在你启用的功能：AI（BYOK）/ IMAP（你的邮箱）/ JD 抓取 / 启动后一次更新检查——明细以 data-flow-matrix.md 为准（隐私承诺的权威底稿） 不支持的用法 自动投递、代登录、把工具当服务端多用户使用（见 ADR keep-writes-human-confirmed.md）

安全相关的取舍（如自动更新链未签名）单列在 ../SECURITY.md，不在本文里重复。

docs.title: 三、数据兼容承诺（工作区格式）
docs.text:
一句话：升级永远不需要你转换数据。

  1. 读时缺列按空值：新版本加了列，你手上的旧 CSV 直接读，缺的列当空处理。
  2. 写时统一表头：写回时按当前表头落盘，缺的列补空——你不需要手工对齐列。注意：手工新增的列不会被保留（写出时按工具的表头重排，多余列连值一起消失）；需要承载额外信息请用既有的备注 / 标签字段，不要手加列。
  3. 不要求迁移：没有「升级前请先跑迁移脚本」这一步——加列、加表都不会让你动数据。
  4. 破坏性变更走过过渡：真要删除或改名列，先登记为废弃（读时兼容），至少一个发布节点后才移除，并在 CHANGELOG.md 的「破坏性变更」里显式列出影响与迁移办法（Keep a Changelog 的 Deprecated → Removed 纪律）。

自检：python tools/jobws.py track check 会点名必填列缺失与枚举外的取值——它是这套承诺的可执行面。

排练（2026-10-02，#208）：上面四条不是散文承诺——tests/fixtures/workspaces/ 下有三组 版本化夹具（v0.3 老表头 / 缺列 / 坏输入），tests/test_workspace_compat.py 每次 CI 都跑一遍 「打开 → 读 → 改 → 重读 → 校验」（含「读路径绝不改文件」与坏输入响亮报错的断言）。 备份一侧另有 tests/test_snapshot_restore.py（30 条）守着那条原则：能生成 zip ≠ 有备份， restore 验证过才算。

已知边界（写清楚比含糊兜住更有用）：

  • 手工改坏表头（例如把「当前阶段」改成别的名字）不在兼容范围内，自检会报必填列缺失。
  • 编码被改成非 UTF-8、两列同名这类「用户侧的结构破坏」同样不支持，但错误信息会指向具体列。
  • 删除类操作不可逆：删前会写一份整表快照到工作区之外（可整份拷回），但工具不提供「一键撤销」。

docs.title: 四、升级路径
docs.text:
• 桌面端：内置自动更新（下载与重启各问一次）；也可直接下载新安装包覆盖安装。
  • 命令行 / 源码：git pull 后重跑 python tools/jobws.py skills install（技能 / 命令 / 子代理三类资产一次同步）；--link 可选，指向真源、免同步。
  • 升级前：建议整份拷走工作区目录（它就是你的数据，没有隐藏状态）。

docs.title: 数据位置（2026-10-05 起，数据根契约 B3）
docs.text:
• 新装默认：<系统用户数据目录>/job-workbench/data（Windows 即 %APPDATA%\job-workbench\data）——四端（命令行 / AI 宿主 / 插件 / 桌面端）共同计算，不依赖安装或仓库位置。
  • 老用户不受影响：旧默认位置（仓库 checkout、%APPDATA%\job-workbench 顶层）已有真实工作区的，原样继续使用，不会被搬迁或改名；诊断（jobws doctor / 设置页「数据位置」卡）会如实标注来源与候选。
  • 想搬家：jobws data-root migrate <新位置>（默认只出计划，--apply 才执行；中断可续跑、事后可回滚），或在设置页「数据位置」卡里预览 → 确认。旧目录在迁移后不会被删除，观察期清理由你裁决。
  • 便携模式：改为显式选择——数据旁放 portable.txt 标记才生效（源码与打包形态同一判据）；「目录可写就便携」的旧规则已退役。

docs.title: 五、这份文档怎么维护
docs.text:
• 判据变了（例如毕业条件的时间门槛）→ 改本文并在 CHANGELOG.md 的 Changed 里记一条。
  • 新增一条「已知边界」时，优先问：能不能改成自检能报出来的错误——能报的就不该只写在文档里。

docs.title: 求职工作台 · 使用手册
docs.text:
English（主版）：usage-guide.md ｜ 本文件是简体中文同步版，内容与主版一致。

从零开始把工作台跑起来，以及日常使用的完整说明。

遇到问题先看最后的「常见问题」，覆盖了黑屏、端口占用等已踩过的坑。

docs.title: 一、一次性环境准备
docs.text: 只需做一次。已配好可跳过。

docs.title: 必装
docs.text: 软件 用途 检查命令 Python 3.12+ 后端与 CLI 脚本（3.12 是支持与 CI 验证的基线；3.9+ 或可运行但未验证） python --version Node.js 18+ 前端构建 node --version Chrome 或 Edge PDF 生成（headless 渲染） 一般自带

docs.title: 安装依赖（各一次）
docs.text:
# 后端依赖（上限已随 3.12 基线逐步放宽、每条跑全量回归后才合；当前值见 web/backend/requirements.txt）
cd <仓库目录>\web\backend
pip install -r requirements.txt
# 后端启动时导入领域包（jobws_core），缺了 uvicorn 会直接退出：
pip install ../../packages/jobws-core

# 前端依赖
cd <仓库目录>\web\frontend
npm install

docs.title: 初始化你的工作区（已有 personal/ 的跳过）
docs.text:
python tools/jobws.py init --target personal --domain hvac-cooling

插件换成你专业的：--domain 可选值见 docs/README.md 的「领域插件」表（含适用人群）。

把 AI 工作流分发到你的 AI CLI（用桌面安装包的用户也要跑一次）——评分 / 投递 / 追踪这些 AI 技能靠这一步分发，不跑的话 Web 界面正常但 AI 侧没有工作流：

python tools/jobws.py skills install --target user

只想先看看界面长什么样、不想先填任何真实信息的话，用 --demo：

python tools/jobws.py init --target demo --demo

它会额外铺一份占位数据（8 条投递 / 3 场面试 / 2 位联系人 / 1 个 Offer / 3 场宣讲会 / 6 道题 / 6 封邮件 / 7 张解析卡 / 1 份简历），公司与人名全是假的，可以直接上手体验或截图； 同时会默认装入 software-backend 插件（demo 数据的方向字段依赖它）。 启动后在右上角工作区下拉里选 demo 即可。

docs.title: 填档案：AGENTS.md（评分的前置条件）
docs.text:
init 之后，工作区根目录会生成 AGENTS.md（模板与逐项说明见 template/AGENTS.example.md）。第三节「硬门槛事实」必须填——学历 / 专业 / 届数 / 英语 / 城市，是岗位评分工作流硬门槛判定的唯一事实源：

  • 不填的后果：字段停留在 [待填] 的岗位会被判成「待补档案」——不打分、不终止，但也没有结论；
  • 填好之后：硬门槛按事实判定，只有明确不满足才终止；
  • 城市要求分两级：硬性不可行（要求本地户籍、必须长期驻外）才判不通过；"本地优先"这类偏好只在「培养与稳定性」里轻度扣分（-3 / -5，合计不超过 5），不再一票否决。

第五节是自定义红线（默认两条：简历动词经得起追问、不编造经历），按需追加。

docs.title: 方式一：一键启动（推荐）
docs.text:
cd <仓库目录>\web
.\start.ps1

脚本会自动：清掉被占用的端口 → 启动后端（8765）→ 启动前端（5173）→ 等待就绪 → 自动打开浏览器。

关闭方式：关掉脚本所在的控制台窗口，两个服务一起停。

docs.title: 方式二：手动启动（需要看后端日志时用）
docs.text:
开两个终端：

# 终端一：后端
cd <仓库目录>\web\backend
python -m uvicorn main:app --port 8765

# 终端二：前端（Windows 必须用 npm.cmd，直接跑 npm 会静默失败）
cd <仓库目录>\web\frontend
npm.cmd run dev

docs.title: 访问地址
docs.text:
地址 是什么 http://localhost:5173 工作台界面（日常用这个） http://localhost:8765/docs 后端 API 交互文档（FastAPI 自动生成）

前端把 /api 请求代理到 8765，所以浏览器只跟 5173 打交道。

docs.title: 方式三：双击 exe（免环境，适合给别人用 / 快速查看）
docs.text:
构建产物在 web/backend/dist/job-workbench-backend/，双击其中的 job-workbench-backend.exe：

  • 没服务在跑 → 启动后端 + 自动打开浏览器（黑色控制台窗口是服务日志，关掉=停服务）
  • 服务已在跑 → 直接打开浏览器，不会重复起服务
  • 端口被其他程序占用 → 人话提示，窗口保持打开（不会闪退）

⚠️ exe 是"干净分发物"，不读你的个人数据。便携版的工作区在 exe 旁边（personal/，默认为空）——这是刻意设计，避免你的求职数据随安装包散播。自己日常用方式一/二（数据在仓库根）；exe 用来验证产品或发给别人。硬要 exe 读自己的数据，设环境变量 JOBWS_DATA_DIR 指向仓库根（不推荐，容易数据分叉）。

重新构建 exe：

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build_backend_exe.ps1

docs.title: 桌面安装包（Electron 壳，v0.1.1 起）
docs.text:
不想配环境可以用 Release 里的 job-workbench-setup-*.exe（Electron 窗口 + 打包好的后端，双击装完即用）。数据目录：安装版在 %APPDATA%\job-workbench\personal\，绿色版（backend exe 旁有 portable.txt）在 exe 旁 personal\——卸载安装版不影响 %APPDATA% 里的数据。

安装包现在是向导式：可以自选安装位置，并选择「为所有用户 / 仅为我」。升级旧版时请沿默认选项（「仅为我」+ 原目录）——选「所有用户」会装到 Program Files 并与旧安装分叉。静默安装仍可用：/S（/D=<目录> 可指定位置）。

桌面版可以调界面缩放：设置页的「界面大小」滑块（拖动即预览，整个界面含文字一起缩放），或 Ctrl + = 放大、Ctrl + - 缩小（0.5 级步进，约 0.58x–1.73x）、Ctrl + 0 复位；级别会记住，重启沿用，滑块与快捷键互相同步。

一键重建安装包（前端 dist → PyInstaller 后端 exe → NSIS）：

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build_desktop.ps1

产物在 web/electron/release/job-workbench-setup-<版本>-win64.exe（产品名英文化为 Job Workbench：安装包与开始菜单项是英文；窗口标题跟随界面语言）。冒烟：<安装包> /S 静默安装到默认的「仅为我」位置（/D=<目录> 可指定位置），启动后验证 http://127.0.0.1:8765。

docs.title: 看板（首页）
docs.text:
打开就是它。回答三个问题：投了几家、几家还在流程中、接下来七天该干什么。

  • 顶部四张统计卡：投递总数 / 流程中 / 近七天待办 / 已过截止（点击可下钻到追踪表）
  • 投递漏斗：每个阶段多少人（待投→已投→笔试→…→签约），点柱子按阶段下钻
  • 待推进：健康度异常（紧急/逾期/停滞）的活跃岗位清单，每条带具体理由，点击下钻
  • 近七天待办：下次动作日期或截止日期落在未来 7 天的记录（可一键顺延 7 天）
  • 近 7 天宣讲会：宣讲会 / 招聘会里时间落在未来 7 天的活动（点条目直达「准备」页的宣讲会页签）
  • 已过截止提醒：还停在「待投」但截止日期已过的记录（红色）
  • 静默提醒：长期无进展的活跃岗位（默认超 14 天）
  • 周期复盘：阶段转化率（从时间线重建）、停留中位天数、失败归因与失败原因聚类

docs.title: 追踪表
docs.text:
所有投递记录的表格。六件事：

  • 筛选与搜索：按阶段 / 方向 / 批次过滤，关键字搜公司、岗位或备注
  • 排序：下次动作日期 / 评分 / 停留天数 / 健康度（紧急 > 逾期 > 停滞 > 正常，徽章悬停显示理由）
  • 改状态：点某行的「当前阶段」下拉框直接改（待投→已投→笔试…），改完自动保存
  • 新增与批量导入：右上「新增投递」逐条录入；「批量导入」粘贴或上传 CSV，先出差异预览（新增/重复/错误分色，带行号与原因），有错误行时禁提交
  • 状态原因：每行就地编辑；进入「已挂 / 已放弃」必须填原因，且这两态一旦进入就不可再改阶段（想重新投要新建一条）
  • 行展开：查看该记录的变更时间线与当前阶段停留天数

两条约束（CLI 与网页同源，自动拦）： 1. 终态不回退：已挂 / 已放弃后「当前阶段」锁定，只可补状态原因与备注 2. 同公司+岗位去重：重复录入会被拦截并提示既有记录 id（挂了之后再投一次则放行）

方向下拉框的选项来自工作区装入的领域插件（config/directions/），不是写死的。

docs.title: 岗位池
docs.text:
管理你看过的岗位。每张卡片显示公司_岗位、评分、档位。

  • 新建岗位：粘贴完整 JD 原文（职责+任职要求）系统原样存档；或粘贴网页链接自动抓取正文（需登录 / 反爬 / 纯 JS 渲染的页面会明确提示手动粘贴，不假装成功）
  • 点开详情：左边 JD 原文，右边解析卡
  • 资格硬门槛（置顶优先）：解析卡顶部的「资格硬门槛」卡片先于分数展示——通过（绿）/ 不通过（红）/ 待补档案（琥珀：档案缺事实，不打分、不终止，卡片点名缺哪些字段并指向 AGENTS.md）/ 待确认（中性描边）四态。不通过时明确标红置顶，这时分数是次要信息（说明资格不够，别投）
  • 评分下钻：四维（技术/经历/方向/培养）每条可点开，展开逐条命中明细——每条带能力分层（Primary/Secondary/Weak）+ 证据标签（精确/模糊/语义徽章）+ 命中说明。想知道"为什么得这个分"点开看
  • 简历差距面板：该 JD 与你简历的差距清单，区分「可召回」（母版里有）与「真实缺口」（只能补经历）
  • 解析卡：评分由 AI 在 CodeBuddy 里完成后写入 解析卡.md，这里自动显示四维度进度条 + 总分 + 档位
  • 还没评分的岗位显示"尚未生成解析卡"及操作指引——网页不做评分，评分是 AI 的工作

docs.title: 简历工坊
docs.text:
双模式：

  • 标准版式（数据驱动）：左结构化表单、右 A4 实时预览；页面直接新建版本；生成 PDF 后回显 ATS 校验与纸型检查；含防超页护栏
  • 版式与强调色：版式下拉内置经典 / 紧凑 / 强调三套（全部单栏、过 ATS 校验；紧凑适合内容多、要压一页）；强调色四档（石墨灰 / 商务蓝 / 深墨绿 / 酒红）与版式自由组合，切换即刷新预览，生成的 PDF 与预览同源。命令行等价物：resume render --template std_compact --resume-accent 酒红
  • 一键导入：上传 PDF / Word(.docx) / Markdown / 纯文本 → 抽取成结构化字段。抽取而非生成：模型未抽到的字段标黄、疑似补全的标红，核对页逐段确认后才落盘
  • AI 改写建议：BYOK 模型只改写既有事实的表述，反编造护栏不过不能采用
  • 导出 Word：零依赖 .doc，方便往网申系统粘贴文本（排版以 PDF 为准）
  • 高级模板（手写 HTML 精排版）：只读浏览与一键生成

底部还有版本谱系：哪版简历投了哪些岗位、各走到哪一步。

docs.title: 准备
docs.text:
投递之前的事归一处——宣讲会、题库与笔记都在这里（2026-09-18 从「进展」页迁来：那页的定位是"投递之后"，这两件恰恰在投递之前）：

  • 宣讲会 / 招聘会：活动时间、形式、地点与收获，可导出 .ics（提前 1 小时提醒）；不推进任何阶段。看板「近 7 天宣讲会」点一下直达这里
  • 题库（两个视图）：「我的题库」= 自建可编辑的 questions.csv（领域 / 科目 / 状态 未看·看过·会了 / 答案要点），可从 03_面试准备/**/*.md 只读解析 → 预览 → 确认导入（两段式）；点任意一行打开详情，在弹窗里改答案要点、标记三态、调难度、改标签与备注——同样先看差异表再确认（确认前不落盘，取消不留痕）；「被问过的」= 面过的问题按公司 + 岗位归集、关键词检索——面试前先过一遍这家公司问过你什么；命令行可 jobws bank export --csv <文件> 导出整个题库、jobws bank import-csv <文件> 从 CSV 导入（预览后凭令牌落盘；导出再导入是幂等的）、jobws bank due 看今日待复习（未看恒在；看过 3 天 / 会了 14 天；空/脏数据保守计待复习）、jobws bank wrong 看错题本（--add/--remove <题目id> 标记——标记就是给「标签」加/去「错题」，界面里在题目详情改标签同效）；jobws bank delete 删题——单题 --id Q012，误导入想整批撤回用 --origin 导入 --today（也可按 --domain / --subject / --keyword / --company 组合）——同样先给「将删哪几行」的预览，确认后凭令牌落盘，落盘前把整表快照写到工作区之外（默认 <快照根>/<工作区名>/question-deletes/questions-before-delete-<时间戳>.csv，jobws apply 会打印确切路径；恢复 = 回到删除前一刻的整表状态，把那份 CSV 复制回 05_投递追踪/questions.csv——删除之后的其它改动会一并被冲掉）。落盘前还核对行指纹（id + 题目 + 领域 + 科目 + 创建日期）：id 会被复用，预览之后那一行被改过或被新题顶替就整体拒绝、要求重新预览。界面里在题目详情弹窗底部点「删除这道题」同效（批量删只在命令行）
  • 新增题目（2026-09-21）：面板顶部的「新增题目」自拟一道题入库——填领域 / 科目 / 难度 / 答案要点，先预览将写入的字段、确认后落盘（与 CLI jobws bank add、MCP preview_add_question 同一份校验）；列表每行还会带「待复习」与「错题」徽章——到期按复习间隔算（未看 恒在、看过 3 天、会了 14 天），鼠标悬停徽章能看到"为什么算到期"；错题按标签判定（与训练面板同一套标签口径）
  • 训练（题库的「练」入口）：抽题 → 盲答（答案默认折叠）→ 展开对答案 → 自评三态 / 标错题 → 下一题。三种模式：重练队列（错题 ∪ 今日待复习）、只错题、随机；可按领域 / 科目 / 状态 / 关键词收窄。写操作零新增（自评改「状态」、标错题改「标签」，都先看差异再确认）；命令行同效：jobws bank drill --mode due|wrong|random --n 5。三处口径要留意：本轮存在会话里——每写一题工作区指纹会触发整页刷新，抽到的题与进度（含折叠状态）会原样回来，不会被刷新清空；「未看」在状态本来就是未看时不发写请求（没有可写的差异），直接进下一题；「看过」按复习规则不写「最近复习」，该题因此仍在重练队列里（未看 / 看过但没记录 → 保守计待复习），要让它 14 天后才再出现就点「会了」。一轮走完的结束卡会给出本轮真正落盘的写入数（取消 / 预览失败 / 冲突不计）与题库三态现状——"会了"在涨才是进度。可以全程用键盘：空格 / Enter 看答案、1 / 2 / 3 三态自评、W 标错题、← / → 上一题 / 下一题、Esc 关掉确认卡（请求在飞时 Esc 不响应）；焦点在输入框或下拉里时不抢键——打开「一轮题数」下拉后空格不会变成"看答案"，盲答纪律不被自己破坏
  • 笔记：03_面试准备 与 04_知识库 的 Markdown 直接读——左侧目录树（README 显示为「目录说明」、_模板_/_示例_ 淡显、空文件与读不了的文件带标记、可按文件名过滤），右侧渲染成正文（标题 / 列表 / 勾选框 / 表格 / 代码块 / 引用），长文右侧有「本页大纲」，超 256 KB 截断并显式告知。改内容用自己的编辑器，切回来 10 秒内自动刷新（并回到原页签与原文件）；勾选框可点——点一下弹出「原行 → 新行」差异，确认后只改这一行的一个字符，文件其余内容一个字节都不动（走全站唯一的两段式写通道；预览之后这一行若被改过则拒绝并要求重新预览）；全文搜索可按关键词搜文件名与正文，点结果直接打开并滚到命中行（命中过多只列前 50 条并说明；读不动或超过 256 KB 的文件会列出"没搜全"，不静默少给）

docs.title: 进展
docs.text:
投递之后的主战场，四个子 Tab：

  • 面试：三段式记录（问题 → 回答要点 → 复盘），48 小时内待定的琥珀高亮，一键导出 .ics 日历
  • 邮件：往来邮件台账（面试邀约 / 笔试通知 / 拒信…）——可关联投递记录、标签行内改；有 Message-ID 的邮件给「打开原邮件」（Gmail 搜索深链），无可用深链的邮箱（Outlook / QQ / 163 等）给「复制主题去邮箱搜索」的降级提示；会议链接列承接解析出的入会地址（腾讯会议 / Zoom / Teams / Meet…）；邮件不会自动改阶段
  • 联系人：招聘方联系人跟进节奏，超期琥珀提醒，一键「已联系」
  • Offer 对比：多个 offer 的已知事实并排，只并排、不推荐

docs.title: 素材库
docs.text: 事实库（00_事实库/）的只读浏览（由 CLI / AI 生成维护）：事实卡以正文排版显示（表格 / 勾选框 / 引用 / 代码块），超 256 KB 截断并显式告知；外部改完切回来 10 秒内自动刷新。简历相关文件已迁往「简历工坊」（2026-09-03），此处不再重复展示。

docs.title: 设置（Provider）
docs.text:
导航栏「设置」页配置 AI Provider（BYOK，自带 key）：

  • 服务商预设：从下拉选一家（DeepSeek / 智谱 GLM / 通义千问 / Kimi / 硅基流动 / OpenAI），地址模板自动填入；也可选「自定义（兼容 OpenAI）」手填任意兼容端点。地址写法有问题时只给非阻断提示（例如通义千问必须用 …/compatible-mode/v1、不要把 /chat/completions 当 base_url 填），不拦你保存——很多网关的路径本就是自定义的。
  • Base URL：OpenAI 兼容端点（含 /v1，如 https://api.orcarouter.ai/v1）
  • API Key：只存本地，界面只显示脱敏后的末尾 4 位
  • 默认模型：在这里设一次，简历导入 / 简历改写 / 邮件 AI 三处共用；三处仍可就地临时改，但那是本地覆盖，不会改掉这里的默认值。留空则三处都要求手填。
  • 测试连接：调 {base_url}/models 验证 key 有效并列出模型（同时给出总数与"只显示前 N 个"的说明）；返回的模型名是可点的小胶囊，点一下即填入默认模型。拉不到列表不代表不能用——有些服务没实现 /models，直接手填模型名即可。出网 HTTPS 默认校验证书（抓取 JD、简历改写同一策略）：本机证书库加载失败时会拒绝连接并提示修证书库（certmgr.msc），不会静默跳过校验——key 不会在未校验的连接上发出。显式降级用 JOBWS_HTTP_TLS=insecure（不推荐）
  • 数据与隐私：整包导出 zip、快照备份到系统用户目录、快照一键还原（先演练后落盘）、诊断包导出（版本 / 平台 / 自检摘要 / 日志尾部——不含工作区数据与凭证）、打开数据目录、无遥测声明
  • 到点提醒：开关 + 「提前几天」（3 / 5 / 7 天）；通知按事项每天一次，点通知直达追踪表对应记录（详见「进展」章的完整口径）
  • 设置页可搜索（含 @modified 只看改过的项）与单项还原；改动项带标记
  • 导成 Obsidian 笔记（命令行）：python tools/jobws.py export --obsidian <目录>——八张 CSV 各成一个目录、每行一笔记，frontmatter 带上原表全部字段（供 Obsidian Bases / Dataview 过滤排序），题库笔记带 spaced-repetition 卡片语法；输出目录带时间戳、不覆盖旧导出、不改工作区（是快照，不是同步）。加 --notes 另把 03_面试准备 / 04_知识库 / 00_事实库 的 Markdown 投影成笔记（保留目录层级、全量不截断、正文按原意搬运），这样手机上除了刷题也读得到材料全文；训练卡目录不重复投影（它已在题库里）；隐藏文件（草稿、原子写临时名等）按设计跳过、不入清单，读失败与超 2 MiB 的单篇跳过并列进导出目录的 README；导出目录必须在工作区之外（落在里面会直接报错）。更新手机端：加 --sync-to <固定的库目录>，把新快照镜像进一个固定名字的 Obsidian 库——白名单条目（八张表目录 / README.md / jobws.base / 材料目录）按托管语义镜像（会被覆盖；源里删了的题库里也删，有删除时必须加 --yes 确认，否则拒绝执行、库目录零改动）；白名单之外的文件与库里的 .obsidian/ 一个字节不动；只差复习注释（<!--SR:…-->）或空白（空行 / 行尾空格）的笔记不覆盖——前者是手机刷出的进度，被覆盖就归零；正文真改了才更新（那篇笔记里的卡进度归零）。没有强制覆盖开关：确要对齐就删掉库目录里对应文件后重跑（会被当「新增」复制过去）。每次先打印「新增 / 更新 / 删除」计划再执行，--dry-run 只看计划不改库；升级版本后第一次同步先 --dry-run（渲染模板若变会整库更新、所有卡进度归零）。更新的完整顺序（手工拷贝时）：① 手机库拷回电脑、覆盖电脑上的库目录（把进度带回来）→ ② 跑同步 → ③ 把库目录拷回手机；用网盘双向同步则该往返自动完成
  • 还没有 API Key？：未存 key 时，页面会给出一个推荐 Provider 的注册入口，以及一个「一键填入该 Provider 端点」的按钮（预设值只在源码里定义一处）。这个入口在界面上明确标注为推广链接——通过它注册会给本项目作者返佣，你的价格与权益不受影响；点击只是打开网页，不会有任何数据从本应用发出。该入口当前指向 OrcaRouter。

本工作台的 AI 判断默认由 AI CLI（CodeBuddy 等）完成，Provider 是可选的 BYOK 增强入口（简历导入 / AI 改写用）。

docs.title: 只读邮箱拉取（可选）
docs.text:
如果你的邮箱支持 IMAP，工作台可以把最近的招聘邮件拉回来，省掉逐封复制粘贴。在设置页 → 「邮箱只读拉取」里配置（填 IMAP 授权码，不是网页登录密码；多数邮箱要先在网页版设置里开启 IMAP 服务）。

支持哪些邮箱：配置区顶部是服务商下拉——QQ 邮箱 / Foxmail、网易 163、网易 126、yeah.net、Gmail、Outlook / Hotmail、阿里云邮箱、新浪邮箱、搜狐邮箱，另加「其它（手工填写）」。选中即带出服务器与端口，你自己改过之后就不会再被覆盖；也可以只填邮箱地址、服务器留空按域名推断。每个服务商自带就地引导（去网页版哪里开、授权码 / 应用专用密码怎么拿）；163 / 126 / yeah.net 另有一条硬要求——客户端必须在打开文件夹之前声明身份（IMAP ID），本工作台会自动完成，你不用管。Outlook / Hotmail 个人账号暂不支持：微软自 2024-09-16 起停用基本认证，第三方客户端必须走 OAuth2，而本工作台目前只有「用户名 + 授权码」，所以界面上直接标注并说明原因，而不是留一个填了就错的输入框（可行性调研见 OAuth2 连 IMAP 的可行性）。测试连接成功后可以点「读取可用文件夹」拿候选（只读 LIST，点一次连一次），点一下填入、仍可手填。

它怎么工作、以及它不会做什么：

  • 只读：连接使用 SELECT (readonly) 与 BODY.PEEK——不发信、不标已读、不移动、不删除任何邮件。
  • 只在点击时连接：只有你点「从邮箱拉取」时才会连一次邮箱——没有后台定时器、轮询或连接保活。
  • 凭证默认存进系统凭据管理器：桌面版把授权码写进 Windows 凭据管理器，工作区里的 config/imap.json 只保留一条引用；界面与错误消息里脱敏，也不会进入导出 / 备份 zip。源码 / CLI 形态（或显式 JOBWS_CREDENTIAL_STORE=plaintext）是明文回退：那时授权码就写在 <工作区>/config/imap.json 里，能读到你用户目录的进程都能读到它——请把工作区当敏感目录看待，不要放在同步盘或公共共享里。桌面版读到旧明文会自动迁移进凭据管理器；迁移写失败时明文原样保留（绝不丢钥匙）。换电脑、换 Windows 账户，或把工作区目录拷到别的机器之后，系统里取不到这条引用——应用会明确提示「重新保存」，而不是假装成「还没配置」。需要「忘掉」这把钥匙时，设置页可以直接清除已保存的凭据——系统存储里的条目与配置文件里的引用会一并删除（之后再用需重新输入）。
  • 默认校验服务器证书：连接会对邮件服务器证书做系统证书库校验。如果本机 Windows 证书库有损坏条目，create_default_context() 会失败、连接被拒绝（授权码不能在未校验的连接上传输）。确认了解风险——连接可能被中间人截获——后，可显式设置环境变量 JOBWS_IMAP_TLS=insecure 跳过校验。
  • 默认 dry-run：拉取只列出邮件，在你逐条确认建议之前不会往追踪表写任何东西。

常见流程：投递追踪 → 「从邮箱拉取」 → 选时间范围（最近 7 / 30 / 90 天）→ 本地关键词筛选 → 点一封邮件 → 核对解析出的建议 → 确认写回。正文的三种口径界面上都会标注：拉取列表是原文（保留引用与签名、超 140 字截断）；点开后预填的是完整原文（后端上限 4000 字，顶到上限标「已截断」）；✨建议卡里的「出处」是摘录（已去掉引用与签名、仅用于解析）——三处不同是刻意的，不是数据丢了。如果这封邮件对应的投递还没记录，空态里会直接给一个「创建记录」表单（当前阶段默认按邮件内容推断）。

拉取列表里的邮件有三条去向：点邮件正文 = 走「解析 → 建议 → 确认」更新投递状态；点 ✨ = 就地展开解析建议（时间 / 截止事项 / 链接有效期 / 会议链接 / 建议阶段 / 对应岗位，共六类，每条都带原文出处与把握程度，逐条确认才写入——邀请类邮件优先按日历附件解析，比正文正则可靠）；点右侧的「＋」小图标 = 把这封邮件的元数据记入邮件台账（主题 / 发件人 / 日期 / Message-ID）——之后到「进展 → 邮件」里补标签与关联，不用再手打一遍。

解析建议里，把握程度为「需核对」的取值（原文没写年份、相对日期如「明天」「本周五」）必须勾选「我已核对取值」才允许写入；会议链接卡片可以直接复制或打开，写进台账后也能在「进展 → 邮件」里再次打开或复制。解析建议只在拉取流程里出现——手工粘贴的正文没有日历附件，仍走「粘贴邮件」的原有解析对话框。配置了 BYOK Provider（设置 → Provider）之后，底部还会出现可选 AI 增强：填模型名后手动跑一次，同一条建议链路、一律标「AI」且同样需要你核对——AI 只产建议，绝不直接写入。

正文里「请在 X 前完成在线测评 / 笔试」这类句子会被识别为截止事项（第五类候选）：卡片上带任务名（如"完成在线测评"）与日期，确认后同时写入投递记录的「下次动作日期」与「下次动作」。这两个字段正是到点提醒（看板「近七天待办」与系统通知）读的，所以倒计时会自动出现，不需要额外设置；相对日期支持「今天 / 明天 / 后天 / 大后天 / 本周X / 下周X」（后两者按周一为起点），算出的日期若已过去，那就是"已过期"信号，按「需核对」提示你确认。「N 天内 / N 个工作日内 / 链接 N 小时内有效」这类时长表达以邮件发出的那天为基准（三天前收到的邮件今天再看应当已经过期），工作日跳过周末、不跳法定节假日；「链接…有效」与「要交的东西」是两类候选（前者是链接会失效，要你复制保存）。

到点提醒的完整口径（桌面端）：设置页可调「提前几天提醒」（3 / 5 / 7 天，默认 3）。满足任一条就发一条系统通知：已过期（含「截止日期已过仍待投」与「下次动作日期已过」两类，按过期天数排在前）、提前 N 天内的待办（今天到期的与还剩几天的在正文里分开写）、近 7 天宣讲会。去重是按事项、每天一次——同一条今天报过就不再报，但今天新出现的照样会报（旧口径"一天只报一次"会把新出现的截止项漏掉）。点通知会跳到追踪表并自动展开那一条，不用自己找。应用内容区顶部还有一条常驻提醒条（读同一个端点、受同一个开关约束）：打开应用就能看到「N 条已过期 / 近 N 天 N 条待办 / N 场宣讲会」，点一下跳到对应页面；没有到点事项时它不出现、也不占位。关掉开关，通知与提醒条一起停；关窗即停，没有后台服务、不建托盘。

docs.title: 四、让 AI 干活：jwb-jd / jwb-apply 工作流
docs.text: 网页负责看和记，判断类的工作交给 AI。在 CodeBuddy 里用自然语言：

docs.title: 接进别的 AI 宿主（MCP，可选）
docs.text:
工作台还能作为一个 MCP 服务接进支持 MCP 的其它 AI 宿主（Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI 等）：AI 能读投递记录、岗位池与看板，并在你确认之后写入 （先给差异表，你点头才落盘）。

  • 安装与三种宿主的配置形态：docs/mcp-integration.md（配置键名按宿主不同，别照抄）
  • 四个入口（命令行 / AI 宿主 / 编辑器插件 / 桌面界面）各能做什么：docs/four-ends.md

docs.title: 解析一个岗位（jwb-jd 工作流）
docs.text:
把 JD 原文贴给我，或者说"解析这份 JD"。AI 会：

  1. 在 personal/01_岗位池/<公司>_<岗位>/ 存 JD 原文
  2. 跑硬门槛过滤（学历→专业→届数→英语→城市，对照 personal/AGENTS.md）
  3. 通过后四维度评分（技术30/经历25/方向30/培养15），回查事实卡核验
  4. 校验加总并输出档位（75–100 强烈投 / 60–74 投 / 45–59 斟酌 / 30–44 大概率跳过 / 0–29 不投）

硬门槛不过会直接拦下，不打分不写材料。比如对外语有硬性要求的岗位会被你的外语红线拦住。

docs.title: 生成投递包（jwb-apply 工作流）
docs.text: 说"给 XX 岗位生成投递包"。AI 会：选对应方向的简历版本 → 按需微调四处（项目事实不动）→ 生成 PDF → ATS 校验（页数/文本层/关键事实）→ 归档到 05_投递追踪/applications/ → 写入追踪表 → 列出改动清单交你确认后 git 提交。

docs.title: 更新进展（jwb-track）
docs.text: 面试完说"把 XX 更新到一面"，或直接在网页追踪表里点下拉框。

docs.title: 改简历后重新出 PDF（jwb-resume 工作流）
docs.text:
说"重建简历 PDF"，或命令行：

python tools/jobws.py resume --workspace personal --version hvac

docs.title: 五、CLI 命令速查（不用网页时）
docs.text:
所有命令在仓库根目录执行。--workspace personal 可省略（默认就是它）。

# 追踪表
python tools/jobws.py track list                        # 全部记录
python tools/jobws.py track list --due-within 7         # 未来 7 天到期
python tools/jobws.py track list --stage 笔试           # 按阶段筛
python tools/jobws.py track add --company "某公司" --role "岗位" --direction hvac --batch 正式批 ...
python tools/jobws.py track update --id A001 --stage 一面 --next "准备口述" --next-date 2026-09-10
python tools/jobws.py track history --id A001           # 变更时间线
python tools/jobws.py track import --file 待导入.csv --dry-run   # CSV 批量导入（只预览差异）
python tools/jobws.py track import --file 待导入.csv             # 预览通过后写入
python tools/jobws.py track interview add --app A001 --round 一面 --questions "..."   # 面试记录
python tools/jobws.py track contact add --name "张工" --app A001   # 招聘方联系人
python tools/jobws.py track offer add --company "某公司" --monthly "..."  # Offer 事实
python tools/jobws.py track mail add --subject "面试邀请（一面）" --app A001 --tag 邀约  # 邮件台账
python tools/jobws.py track mail list --app A001        # 某条投递的往来邮件
python tools/jobws.py track check                       # schema 自检（坏文件隔离）

# 投递漏斗看板（Markdown，含周期复盘与失败原因聚类）
python tools/jobws.py report --stdout

# 简历 PDF + ATS 校验
python tools/jobws.py resume --workspace personal            # 全部版本
python tools/jobws.py resume --version hvac                  # 指定版本
python tools/jobws.py resume render --workspace personal     # 数据驱动标准版式
python tools/jobws.py resume render --template std_compact --resume-accent 酒红   # 换版式 + 强调色

# JD 解析卡评分校验
python tools/jobws.py jd "personal/01_岗位池/<目录>/解析卡.md" --domain hvac-cooling --direction hvac
python tools/jobws.py jd --gap --resume hvac "personal/01_岗位池/<目录>/解析卡.md"   # JD↔简历差距

上文的阶段名（笔试、一面……）会原样写进你的数据文件，所以界面与文档里保留中文；它们按固定词表校验（STAGES，定义在 jobws_core.tracker），不能简单改成英文。

docs.title: 六、数据在哪、怎么备份
docs.text:
所有数据都是纯文本文件，在 personal/ 下：

目录 内容 00_事实库/ 项目/实习事实卡——唯一事实源 01_岗位池/ 每个岗位一个目录：JD 原文 + 解析卡 02_简历工坊/ 简历 md + HTML 模板 + 生成的 PDF + 照片 03_面试准备/ 自我介绍、项目表达、行为面、复盘（题库已迁至下方 05_投递追踪/questions.csv） 04_知识库/ 知识词典目录——按需自建（骨架里只有一份 README） 05_投递追踪/ 八张表：tracker.csv（投递）+ history.csv（变更时间线）+ interviews / contacts / offers / talks / mails / questions.csv AGENTS.md 你的档案：硬门槛事实、诚实红线

备份（重要）：personal/ 已整体 gitignore——git 不追踪你的数据，仓库镜像克隆不会带走它们。主备份方式：

  1. 设置页「立即备份」：快照到系统用户目录（工作区之外，推荐，一键完成）
  2. 设置页「整包导出 zip」：随时可带走的完整工作区

⚠️ 分享仓库给任何人之前无需担心数据——personal/ 不在仓库里；但不要把 personal/ 目录本身发给别人（含姓名、照片、联系方式）。

docs.title: 打开 localhost:5173 黑屏 / 连不上
docs.text:
按顺序排查：

  1. 服务活着吗：cd web && .\start.ps1 重启（会自动清端口）。Vite 是前台进程，启动它的终端关了服务就没了——这是最常见原因
  2. 浏览器缓存了旧版 JS：Ctrl + F5 强制刷新
  3. 还是黑屏：页面现在有 ErrorBoundary，崩溃会显示错误文字而不是黑屏；按 F12 看 Console，把报错发我

docs.title: 启动脚本报错
docs.text:
start.ps1 用了三层回退定位仓库根（参数 → 脚本位置 → 向上找 AGENTS.md）。如果报"无法定位仓库根"，在仓库目录内运行，或显式指定：

.\start.ps1 -RepoRoot <仓库目录>

docs.title: npm 命令没反应
docs.text: Windows 下手动启动前端必须用 npm.cmd run dev。直接 npm run dev 在某些调用方式下会静默失败（无报错、端口不监听）。

docs.title: 端口被占用
docs.text:
start.ps1 会自动释放 8765/5173。手动释放：

Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8765 -State Listen | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force }

docs.title: 网页里岗位卡片没有评分
docs.text: 评分必须满足两点：解析卡.md 存在 且 四项加总与总分自洽（会被 jd_score 规则校验）。如果手改过解析卡导致格式不对，网页会当作"未评分"。用 python tools/jobws.py jd <解析卡路径> 看具体哪里不自洽。

docs.title: CSV 用 Excel 打开乱码
docs.text: 不会乱码——写入用了 UTF-8 BOM（utf-8-sig）。如果乱码，说明文件被其他工具重写过编码，联系我修复。

docs.title: 双击 exe 没反应
docs.text:
console=True 黑窗一闪而过通常意味着启动即失败。原因与处置：

  1. 端口被占 → exe 现在会给出明确提示并保持窗口（除非被杀软拦截）。先 Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8765 -State Listen 看占用者
  2. 刚构建的 exe 数据为空是正常的——见上文"方式三"（exe 是干净分发物，不读仓库根数据）

docs.title: 网页标题显示 "Vite + React + TS"
docs.text: 旧版构建残留的缓存或未刷新产物。Ctrl+F5 强刷；仍不行则重新构建前端（cd web/frontend && npm.cmd run build）并重启后端。新的正确标题是 "Job Workbench"（窗口标题跟随界面语言，中文界面为「求职工作台」）。

docs.title: .ps1 脚本报 ParserError / 中文乱码
docs.text: 含中文的 .ps1 必须存成 UTF-8 带 BOM。若文件被无 BOM 地重存，Windows PowerShell 5.1 会按 GBK 误解码导致语法错误。两个脚本（start.ps1、build_backend_exe.ps1）都已带 BOM；手动改它们时不要去掉 BOM。

docs.title: 八、技术文档导航
docs.text: 想了解 看哪份 整体架构（三层分离、领域插件） docs/specs/2026-08-30-general-workbench-design.md Web 层设计（API 契约、并发与安全） docs/specs/2026-08-30-web-prototype-design.md AI 工作流定义 根 skills/ 下九个 SKILL.md（五个求职向 + 一个扩展向 + 三个开发向；主文件精简、细节在各自的 references/。tools/jobws.py skills install 一并分发技能 / 命令 / 子代理三类资产到各 AI CLI） 毕业条件 / 支持策略 / 数据兼容承诺 docs/support-and-compatibility.md（什么时候算正式版、支持哪些环境、升级为什么不要求转换数据） 关键决策（为什么这样定） docs/decisions/ 下的短档（写入人工确认、单一发布节点、数据兼容、hooks 默认关闭） 文档总索引 docs/README.md

docs.title: 外观：主题与字体
docs.text:
设置页「外观」卡（设备级偏好，只影响这台机器、不随工作区导出）：

  • 主题：默认暗之外内置浅色与 8 套开源皮肤（Catppuccin Mocha·Latte / Nord / Tokyo Night / Rosé Pine + Dawn / Gruvbox / Everforest），支持「跟随系统」；「自定义主题…」改关键色并实时显示对比度，保存后进入主题列表；可导入 tweakcn / shadcn 的 CSS 或导出的 JSON。
  • 字体：界面字体 12 款可选（Inter 默认，另有 Geist、IBM Plex Sans、Manrope、Plus Jakarta Sans、DM Sans、Figtree、Outfit、Public Sans、Source Sans 3、Work Sans、Atkinson Hyperlegible Next，以及系统字体与衬线）；等宽字体独立可选 6 款（Maple Mono 默认，另有 JetBrains Mono、Fira Code、Geist Mono、IBM Plex Mono、Source Code Pro），管代码 / 编号 / 日期；数字字体另设一槽（Geist Mono 默认，可选 JetBrains Mono、IBM Plex Mono 或「跟随界面字体」），管 KPI / 计数 / 天数 / 百分比等数值。全部随应用本地打包（OFL-1.1、离线可用），只含拉丁子集——中文始终走系统栈。界面字号为连续滑块（80%–150%，步进 5%）。终端字体请在你的终端软件里设置——jobws prefs doctor 会给出推荐清单（Maple Mono / JetBrains Mono / 更纱黑体）。
  • 偏好分层：主题 / 字体是设备级（存本机）；jobws prefs（theme / font / resume_style）是工作区级物料偏好，供 CLI、技能与导出使用。

主题改动会过门禁 jobws lint themes（完整性 / 对比度 / 明度阶梯）——10 套内置主题全部满足正文 4.5:1、大字与图形 3:1。

docs.title: 数据流矩阵（Data Flow Matrix）
docs.text:
回答一个问题：我的什么数据，会在什么时候，去哪里？

本项目无遥测、无项目方云端；除应用启动时的一次更新检查（发往 GitHub 本仓库） 外，所有联网行为只发生在你主动使用对应功能时，且只访问你启用的服务。本表是这句话的 完整展开——它是隐私承诺的权威底稿：界面文案（顶栏提示、设置页「数据与 隐私」与「关于」）与本文不一致时，以本文为准并立即改文案。

功能 本地数据 联网 发给谁 发什么 看板 / 追踪表 / 岗位池（浏览与编辑） CSV / Markdown 工作区文件 否 — — 简历编辑 / 导入核对 简历数据 否 — — AI 改写（可选，需自配模型服务） 所选简历文本 是 你配置的 LLM 服务商（OpenAI 兼容端点） prompt + 你选中的文本；发送前有确认步骤与反编造护栏 模型服务连通性测试 无工作区内容 是 同上 仅探活请求（不含工作区数据） AI 邮件解析（可选） 邮件正文 是 同上 你确认发送的文本 邮件拉取（可选，需自配 IMAP） 邮箱凭证 + 邮件 是 你的邮箱服务商（IMAP） 登录与读取请求；只读——不发送、不修改、不删除，点了才连 岗位 JD 抓取 目标 URL 是 招聘网页所在站点 一次 HTTP GET 更新检查（桌面版） 版本信息 是 GitHub（本仓库 Release） 当前版本与平台（electron-updater 的标准请求）；启动后延迟一次（约 5 秒），失败只进日志 快照 / 导出 / 诊断包 工作区文件 否 — —（凭证与运行时产物被排除在外，见下）

docs.title: 明细与保证
docs.text:
• 凭证：邮箱授权码与 API Key 默认存 Windows 凭据管理器（桌面版）；源码 / CLI 形态或显式 JOBWS_CREDENTIAL_STORE=plaintext 时为明文回退，落在 config/imap.json / config/provider.json 里。两种形态都只存在本机；凭据管理器 形态下配置文件只保留引用（auth_ref / api_key_ref）。导出 / 快照 / 诊断包 一律排除（tests/test_export_privacy.py 做 zip 内容字节级泄漏检测）。
  • AI 功能全部可选：不配置模型服务时所有 AI 入口禁用，无任何外发。
  • 不在上表 = 不出网：除表中行外，应用不发起任何网络请求；开发者侧的 代码图谱类 MCP 工具（GitNexus 等）不随产品分发。
  • MCP 服务与 AI 宿主边界：mcp/ 的 jobws-mcp 走 stdio、服务自身不联网 （只读写本地工作区）；但宿主（Claude / Codex / Gemini 等）拿到工具返回的 数据后，可能按宿主自己的隐私策略将其发送给模型服务——这一层由你选择的 宿主与模型决定，不在本应用控制范围内。不接 MCP 即无此路径（接入方式见 mcp-integration.md）。

docs.title: 治理规则（贡献者）
docs.text: 新增任何出网能力，必须先更新本表（PR 描述里引用对应行）。CI 尚未自动 校验这一点（自动检查列 ROADMAP 候选）；在此之前，评审时未更新矩阵的出网 PR 应被拒绝——这张表是"隐私文案不撒谎"的机器外防线。

docs.title: job-workbench
docs.text:
A local-first, auditable AI-assisted job-search workbench: run the whole pipeline — from JD analysis to offer decision — in plain Markdown & CSV on your own disk. Drive it from the desktop app, the browser, or your own AI CLI.

Current version: 26.10.0

docs.title: Features at a glance
docs.text:
• Four AI-assisted workflows: jwb-jd (JD parsing & scoring), jwb-apply (application package), jwb-track (tracker & funnel), jwb-resume (PDF rebuild & validation) — all driven by the in-repo jobws CLI; the full command reference is in the usage guide.
  • Web UI: eight pages (dashboard / tracker / job pool / resume workshop / prepare / progress / library / settings) sharing the very same data files as the CLI; one-click resume import that extracts rather than generates, guarded AI rewrite, freely combinable layouts and accent colors — every generated PDF is single-column and ATS-checked.
  • Post-application loop: interview records with one-click .ics export, recruiter follow-ups, offer comparison (side-by-side facts, never a recommendation), version lineage, conversion retros, failure clustering, application health in four states — each with concrete, human-checkable reasons, never a black-box score.
  • Read-only email fetch (optional): pull recent recruiting emails with your own IMAP authorization code and turn them into per-record status suggestions — read-only, connected only when you click, credentials kept local; emails never change stages by themselves.
  • Scoring framework: an eligibility gate first (degree → major → cohort → language → city), then four weighted dimensions → five-tier verdict; jobs with unfilled profile facts are "awaiting profile facts" — not scored, not killed, never guessed.
  • Domain profiles are data, not code: two ship in the box (HVAC & cooling, software backend); author one pure-data profile per the domain contract to switch fields — validated by jobws lint domains.

docs.title: UI Preview
docs.text: The screenshots below are the real interface in English, generated from demo data (jobws init --target demo --demo; companies, roles and names are placeholders). The interface is bilingual — switch it with the 中文 / English control in the header; the same pages in 简体中文 are on the Chinese homepage.

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
# 1. Initialize a workspace — swap --domain for your field; add --demo to just look around
python tools/jobws.py init --target personal --domain hvac-cooling
# 2. Distribute skills / commands / subagents to your AI CLI (CodeBuddy / Claude Code / ~/.agents/skills/)
python tools/jobws.py skills install --target user
# 3. Fill in personal/AGENTS.md (hard eligibility facts), then tell your AI CLI: "parse this JD"

The CLI needs Python 3.12+ (standard library only); PDF generation uses Chrome or Edge. No environment yet? The Download page has the desktop installer (no Python / Node needed).

docs.title: Referral
docs.text: The optional AI features (resume import, AI rewrite) are BYOK — bring a key from any OpenAI-compatible provider. If you do not have one yet, the Settings page offers OrcaRouter as a preset optional provider. Full disclosure: this is a referral link — signing up through it earns the project author a commission; your pricing and benefits are unaffected, and clicking it only opens a web page (nothing is sent from the app by clicking).

docs.title: Download
docs.text:
Latest version: 26.10.0 (released 2026-10-06)

简体中文：下载页

docs.title: Main channel: GitHub Releases
docs.text:
Download the Windows installer (direct link)

That link is the file itself: job-workbench-setup-26.10.0-win64.exe — a Windows x64 installer with wizard-style setup; no Python or Node needed. If the direct link does not open (freshly published, CDN not synced yet), open the release page and pick the file from the Assets section.

GitHub can be slow or unreachable from some networks. If the release page will not open, or a download keeps breaking, use the backup channel below.

docs.title: Backup channel
docs.text:
Leave a message in the Gitee mirror's Issues telling us which version you need — Gitee is reachable from mainland networks without opening GitHub first; we will reply with a working backup download link. (The main repository's Issues work too when GitHub is reachable.)

To be precise: the installer is 130+ MB, above Gitee's 100 MB attachment limit, so the backup channel can only hand out links (cloud storage etc.), never host the file on Gitee itself; backup links are maintained manually and may lag behind the official release. Please use the main channel whenever GitHub is reachable for you.

docs.title: Unsigned installer and SmartScreen
docs.text:
The installer is not code-signed yet. On first run, Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" — the standard prompt for unsigned software: click More info → Run anyway.

SmartScreen reputation rebuilds per version, so later releases may prompt again; the missing signature does not affect auto-update (integrity is checked against the hash in latest.yml).

docs.title: Verify the download
docs.text:
Starting with v26.9.0, each release ships SHA256SUMS.txt (SHA256 hashes of the installer and latest.yml). After downloading, run this in PowerShell or CMD (substituting the file you actually downloaded):

certutil -hashfile job-workbench-setup-26.10.0-win64.exe SHA256

Compare the output with the hash for the same file in SHA256SUMS.txt on the release page: a match means the file is intact and identical to what the publisher uploaded. To be precise, this proves integrity; for an unsigned build it is not proof of publisher identity.

docs.title: job-workbench · Usage Guide
docs.text:
Everything you need to take the workbench from zero to running, plus how to use it day to day.

If something breaks, go straight to the FAQ at the end — it covers the traps already hit (blank screen, ports taken by another process, and so on).

简体中文同步版：usage-guide.zh-CN.md

docs.title: I. One-time environment setup
docs.text: Do this once. Skip it if your environment is already set up.

docs.title: Required
docs.text: Software What it is for How to check Python 3.12+ Backend and CLI scripts (3.12 is the supported, CI-verified baseline; 3.9+ may run unverified) python --version Node.js 18+ Frontend build node --version Chrome or Edge PDF generation (headless rendering) Usually already present

docs.title: Install dependencies (once each)
docs.text:
# Backend (upper-bound pins — relaxed step by step since the 3.12 baseline, each verified by a full regression run; current values in web/backend/requirements.txt)
cd <repo>\web\backend
pip install -r requirements.txt
# The backend imports the domain package at startup — without it uvicorn exits immediately:
pip install ../../packages/jobws-core

# Frontend
cd <repo>\web\frontend
npm install

docs.title: Initialise your workspace (skip if you already have personal/)
docs.text:
python tools/jobws.py init --target personal --domain hvac-cooling

Swap in your own domain: see the "Domain profiles" table in docs/README.md (with target audiences) for valid --domain values.

Distribute the AI workflows to your AI CLI (desktop-installer users need this once too) — the scoring / application / tracking skills are delivered by this step; without it the web UI works but the AI side has no workflows:

python tools/jobws.py skills install --target user

If you just want to see what it looks like without filling in any real information, use --demo:

python tools/jobws.py init --target demo --demo

That also lays down a full set of placeholder data (8 applications / 3 interviews / 2 contacts / 1 offer / 3 talks & job fairs / 6 question-bank items / 6 emails / 7 parsed JD cards / 1 resume). Every company and person name is fake, so you can click around or take screenshots safely; the software-backend domain profile is installed by default because the demo data's "direction" field depends on it. Once it is running, pick demo from the workspace dropdown in the top-right corner.

docs.title: Fill in your profile: AGENTS.md (the prerequisite for scoring)
docs.text:
After init, AGENTS.md appears at the workspace root (template and per-item notes in template/AGENTS.example.md). Section 3, "Hard-gate facts", must be filled — degree / major / graduation year / English / city; it is the single source of facts for the eligibility gate:

  • If left unfilled: jobs whose fields stay [待填] are classified "awaiting profile facts" — not scored, not terminated, but with no verdict either;
  • Once filled: the gate judges on facts, and only a definite mismatch terminates;
  • City requirements come in two tiers: hard infeasibility (local hukou required, long-term field posting) terminates; preferences like "local candidates preferred" only deduct a few points from "Growth & stability" (-3 / -5, capped at 5 in total) instead of vetoing.

Section 5 carries your custom honesty red lines (two by default: every resume verb must survive questioning; never fabricate experience) — append as needed.

docs.title: II. Day-to-day startup: the web UI
Option 1: one command (recommended)
docs.text:
cd <repo>\web
.\start.ps1

The script clears any occupied ports, starts the backend (8765), starts the frontend (5173), waits until both are ready, and opens your browser.

To stop it: close the console window the script runs in — both services stop together.

docs.title: Option 2: manual startup (when you need backend logs)
docs.text:
Open two terminals:

# Terminal 1: backend
cd <repo>\web\backend
python -m uvicorn main:app --port 8765

# Terminal 2: frontend (on Windows you MUST use npm.cmd; plain npm fails silently)
cd <repo>\web\frontend
npm.cmd run dev

docs.title: Addresses
docs.text:
Address What it is http://localhost:5173 The workbench UI (this is the one you use) http://localhost:8765/docs Backend API docs (generated by FastAPI)

The frontend proxies /api to 8765, so your browser only ever talks to 5173.

docs.title: Option 3: double-click the exe (no environment needed; good for handing to someone or a quick look)
docs.text:
The build output lives in web/backend/dist/job-workbench-backend/ — double-click job-workbench-backend.exe inside it:

  • Nothing is running yet → it starts the backend and opens a browser (the black console window is the service log; closing it stops the service)
  • Already running → it just opens the browser, without starting a second service
  • The port is taken by another program → you get a plain-language message and the window stays open (it does not flash and vanish)

⚠️ The exe is a "clean distribution" and does not read your personal data. The portable workspace sits next to the exe (personal/, empty by default) — that is deliberate, so your job-search data never travels with an installer. Use option 1 or 2 for your own day-to-day work (data lives at the repo root); use the exe to validate a build or to hand to someone else. If you insist on pointing the exe at your own data, set JOBWS_DATA_DIR to the repo root (not recommended — it forks your data).

Rebuild the exe:

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build_backend_exe.ps1

docs.title: Desktop installer (Electron shell, since v0.1.1)
docs.text:
If you would rather not set up an environment at all, grab job-workbench-setup-*.exe from the latest release (an Electron window plus a packaged backend; install it and run). Where data goes: the installed version uses %APPDATA%\job-workbench\personal\; the portable version (a portable.txt next to the backend exe) uses personal\ beside the exe — uninstalling the installed version does not touch the data in %APPDATA%.

The installer is now a wizard: you can pick the installation folder and choose between "for all users" and "just me". When upgrading an existing install, keep the default choices ("just me" + the existing folder) — picking "all users" installs into Program Files and forks away from the old install. Silent install still works: /S (add /D=<dir> to override the folder).

The desktop app can zoom the interface: drag the Interface size slider in Settings (the whole UI scales, text included), or use Ctrl + = / Ctrl + - (half-step, roughly 0.58x–1.73x) / Ctrl + 0 to reset. The level is remembered across restarts, and the slider and the shortcuts stay in sync.

Rebuild the installer in one command (frontend dist → PyInstaller backend exe → NSIS):

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build_desktop.ps1

The output is web/electron/release/job-workbench-setup-<version>-win64.exe (the product name is Job Workbench: installer and Start Menu entry are English; the window title follows the interface language). Smoke test: <installer> /S installs silently to the default per-user location (/D=<dir> overrides the folder), launch it, then check http://127.0.0.1:8765.

docs.title: III. The eight pages of the web UI
Dashboard (home)
docs.text:
This is what opens first. It answers three questions: how many companies have I applied to, how many are still in flight, and what needs doing in the next seven days.

  • Four stat cards at the top: total applications / in progress / to-do in 7 days / past deadline (click to drill into the tracker)
  • Application funnel: how many people at each stage (to apply → applied → written test → … → signed); click a bar to drill into that stage
  • Needs action: active roles with an unhealthy status (urgent / overdue / stalled), each with a concrete reason; click to drill in
  • To-do in 7 days: records whose next-action or deadline falls within the next 7 days (one click to postpone by 7 days)
  • Talks in the next 7 days: talks / job fairs whose time falls within the next 7 days (click to jump to the Talks tab under Prepare)
  • Past deadline: records still sitting at "to apply" whose deadline has passed (red)
  • Silent reminder: active roles with no progress for a long time (over 14 days by default)
  • Cycle review: stage conversion rates (rebuilt from the timeline), median days spent per stage, failure attribution and failure clustering

docs.title: Tracker
docs.text:
A table of every application. Six things you can do:

  • Filter and search: by stage / direction / batch, plus keyword search over company, role and notes
  • Sort: by next-action date / score / days in stage / health (urgent > overdue > stalled > normal; hover the badge for the reason)
  • Change stage: click the "current stage" dropdown on a row to change it (to apply → applied → written test → …); it saves automatically
  • Add, or import in bulk: "Add application" at the top right for one at a time; "Bulk import" to paste or upload a CSV, which first shows a diff preview (added / duplicate / error rows in different colours with line numbers and reasons) and blocks submission while any row has an error
  • Status reason: edit in place per row; moving to "declined / gave up" requires a reason, and once in either of those states the stage can no longer be changed (to apply again, create a new record)
  • Row expansion: see that record's change timeline and how many days it has sat in the current stage

Two rules (shared by CLI and web, enforced automatically): 1. Terminal states do not roll back: after "declined / gave up", the current stage is locked; only the status reason and notes stay editable 2. Deduplicate by company + role: a duplicate entry is blocked and points you at the existing record id (applying again after being declined is allowed)

The options in the direction dropdown come from the domain profiles installed in your workspace (config/directions/), not from a hardcoded list.

docs.title: Job pool
docs.text:
Manage the roles you have looked at. Each card shows company_role, its score and its tier.

  • New role: paste the full JD (responsibilities + requirements) and it is archived verbatim; or paste a URL and let it fetch the page (pages that need a login, block scrapers or render with JS produce an explicit "paste it manually" message — it never pretends to succeed)
  • Open details: JD on the left, parsed card on the right
  • Eligibility gate (pinned above everything): the "hard eligibility" card at the top of the parsed card is shown before the score — pass (green) / fail (red) / awaiting profile facts (amber: your profile is missing facts — not scored, not terminated, the card names what to fill and points at AGENTS.md) / pending (neutral outline). A fail is pinned and highlighted in red, and the score becomes secondary information (it means you are not eligible — do not apply)
  • Score drill-down: each of the four dimensions (technical / experience / direction / growth) expands to per-item hits, each with a capability tier (Primary/Secondary/Weak), an evidence label (exact / vague / semantic badge) and a hit explanation. If you want to know "why this score", open it
  • Resume gap panel: the gaps between this JD and your resume, split into "recallable" (it exists in your master resume) and "real gaps" (only new experience can fill them)
  • Parsed card: the score is produced by the AI inside CodeBuddy and written to 解析卡.md; this page renders the four dimension bars, total score and tier
  • Roles without a score show "no parsed card yet" plus instructions — the web UI does not score anything; scoring is the AI's job

docs.title: Resume workshop
docs.text:
Two modes:

  • Standard layout (data-driven): structured form on the left, live A4 preview on the right; create versions right on the page; after generating a PDF it reports the ATS check and paper-size check, with an overflow guard
  • Layout & accent color: the layout dropdown ships Classic / Compact / Accent (all single-column and ATS-checked; Compact fits more onto one page); four accent presets (石墨灰 / 商务蓝 / 深墨绿 / 酒红 — Graphite / Business blue / Deep green / Wine) combine freely with any layout — switching refreshes the preview, and the generated PDF uses the same parameters. CLI equivalent: resume render --template std_compact --resume-accent 酒红
  • One-click import: upload a PDF / Word (.docx) / Markdown / plain text and it is extracted into structured fields. Extraction, not generation: fields the model did not find are marked yellow, suspected fabrications red, and nothing is written until you confirm section by section
  • AI rewrite suggestions: a BYOK model only rephrases existing facts; suggestions that fail the anti-fabrication guardrails cannot be accepted
  • Export Word: a dependency-free .doc, handy for pasting text into online application systems (the PDF is the source of truth for layout)
  • Advanced template (hand-written HTML, precise layout): read-only viewing and one-click generation

At the bottom there is also a version lineage: which resume version went to which roles, and how far each got.

docs.title: Prepare
docs.text:
Everything before you apply lives in one place — talks, your question bank and notes (moved out of Progress on 2026-09-18, since that page is about the after-applying side):

  • Talks / job fairs: time, format, place and takeaways, exportable to .ics (reminder 1 hour ahead); they do not advance any stage. The dashboard's "Talks in the next 7 days" jumps straight here
  • Question bank (two views): My bank = your own editable questions.csv (domain / subject / status 未看·看过·会了 / answer notes), which you can fill by read-only parsing → preview → confirm from 03_面试准备/**/*.md (two-phase); click any row to open its details and edit the answer notes, flip the three-state status, adjust difficulty, or edit tags and notes right there — the same two-phase feel (review the diff, then confirm; nothing is written before you confirm, and cancelling leaves no trace); Asked before = questions you were actually asked, grouped by company + role, with keyword search — read what this company already asked you before the next round. On the CLI, jobws bank export --csv <file> exports the whole bank, jobws bank import-csv <file> imports one (preview first, then apply with a token; exporting and re-importing is idempotent), jobws bank due lists today's review (unseen is always due; seen 3 days / known 14 days; empty or dirty dates count as due, conservatively), and jobws bank wrong shows the wrong-answer book (--add/--remove <id> toggles it — tagging is just adding/removing the "错题" tag, same effect as editing tags in the question details dialog); jobws bank delete removes questions — a single one with --id Q012, or a whole mistaken import with --origin 导入 --today (also combinable with --domain / --subject / --keyword / --company). Deletion keeps the same preview-first flow (it lists exactly which rows would go, including source and creation date), then applies with a token; before writing it snapshots the whole table outside the workspace (default path <snapshot root>/<workspace name>/question-deletes/questions-before-delete-<timestamp>.csv — jobws apply prints the exact path; to restore, copy that CSV back over 05_投递追踪/questions.csv, which resets the table to the moment before the deletion, so any later edits are overwritten as well). It also re-checks a row fingerprint (id + question + domain + subject + created date) before writing: ids get reused, so if the row was edited or replaced after the preview, the whole deletion is refused and you must preview again. In the UI, "Delete this question" sits at the bottom of the question details dialog (bulk delete is CLI-only)
  • Adding a question yourself (2026-09-21): "Add question" at the top of the panel adds one card to the bank — fill in domain / subject / difficulty / answer notes and it goes through the same preview the fields, then confirm flow (the very same validation as the CLI jobws bank add and the MCP preview_add_question). Rows also carry a "due" and a "wrong" badge — due is computed from the review intervals (unseen is always due; seen 3 days, known 14 days) and hovering the badge explains why it counts as due; "wrong" follows the tag (the same tag rule the training panel uses)
  • Training (the "practice" entry for your bank): draw questions → answer blind (the answer is collapsed by default) → reveal and compare → self-grade across the three states / flag as wrong → next question. Three modes: the retry queue (wrong ∪ due today), wrong-only, and random; narrow by domain / subject / status / keyword. No new write path — self-grading edits "status", flagging edits "tags", both preview-then-confirm; the CLI equivalent is jobws bank drill --mode due|wrong|random --n 5. Three behaviours worth knowing: the round lives in the session — every write trips the workspace fingerprint and refreshes the page, but the drawn questions and your progress (including the collapsed state) come back exactly as they were (the token itself is not kept; it expires in ten minutes); an "未看" card that is already unseen does not fire a write request (there is nothing to change) and moves straight to the next question; and "看过" deliberately does not write "recently reviewed", so the card stays in the retry queue (unseen, or seen without a recorded review date, conservatively counts as due) — press "会了" if you want it gone for 14 days. The finish card at the end of a round reports how many writes actually landed (cancelled, failed previews and conflicts do not count) plus the current three-state split of your bank — seeing "会了" grow is the actual progress signal. The whole round can be driven from the keyboard: Space / Enter reveals, 1 / 2 / 3 self-grade across the three states, W flags as wrong, ← / → move between questions, Esc closes the confirmation card (but not while a request is in flight). Keys are not captured while focus sits in an input or a dropdown — opening the "questions per round" select does not turn Space into "reveal", so the blind-answer discipline is not broken by the UI itself
  • Notes: read the Markdown in 03_面试准备 and 04_知识库 right in the app — a directory tree on the left (README shows as "Directory guide", _模板_/_示例_ templates are dimmed, empty and unreadable files are flagged, filter by file name), rendered text on the right (headings / lists / checkboxes / tables / code blocks / quotes) with an "On this page" outline; files over 256 KB are truncated with an explicit notice. Edit files in your own editor — the view refreshes within ~10 s (returning to the same tab and file); checkboxes are clickable: a click shows the "before → after" line diff and, once confirmed, flips exactly one character on that line — the rest of the file stays byte-identical (it goes through the app's single two-phase write path; if the line changed after the preview, the write is refused and asks for a fresh preview). Full-text search looks for a keyword in file names and body text; picking a hit opens the file and scrolls to that line (only the first 50 hits are listed, and it says so; files that cannot be read or exceed 256 KB are listed as "not searched fully" rather than silently skipped)

docs.title: Progress
docs.text:
The main arena after you apply. Four sub-tabs:

  • Interviews: three-part record (question → answer points → retro); anything still pending within 48 hours is highlighted amber; one-click export to .ics
  • Emails: a ledger of messages (interview invites, test notices, rejections…), linkable to an application record with inline tag editing; emails with a Message-ID get "Open original" (a Gmail search deep link) while mailboxes without a usable deep link (Outlook / QQ / 163 …) get a "copy the subject and search in your mailbox" fallback; a Meeting link column carries the parsed join URL (Tencent Meeting / Zoom / Teams / Meet…); emails never change stages automatically
  • Contacts: follow-up cadence for recruiter contacts, amber when overdue, one-click "contacted"
  • Offer comparison: known facts of several offers side by side. Side by side only — no recommendation

docs.title: Library
docs.text: Read-only view of the fact base (00_事实库/, maintained by the CLI / AI): fact cards are rendered as formatted text (tables / checkboxes / quotes / code blocks); files over 256 KB are truncated with an explicit notice; edits made outside refresh within ~10 s. Résumé-related files moved to Resume Studio (2026-09-03) and are no longer shown here.

docs.title: Settings (Provider)
docs.text:
The "Settings" page in the nav configures your AI provider (BYOK, bring your own key):

  • Provider preset: pick one from the dropdown (DeepSeek / Zhipu GLM / Qwen / Kimi / SiliconFlow / OpenAI) and the endpoint template fills itself in; or choose Custom (OpenAI-compatible) and type any compatible endpoint. A suspicious URL only earns a non-blocking hint (Qwen needs the …/compatible-mode/v1 path, and /chat/completions is not a base URL) — saving is never blocked, because plenty of gateways use custom paths.
  • Base URL: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (including /v1, e.g. https://api.orcarouter.ai/v1)
  • API Key: stored locally only; the UI shows just the masked last 4 characters
  • Default model: set it once here and resume import / resume rewriting / email AI all share it. Each of the three can still be changed in place — that change is a local override and never rewrites this default. Leave it blank and all three ask you for a model name.
  • Test connection: calls {base_url}/models to verify the key and list models (it also reports the total, and says so when only the first N are shown); the returned model names are clickable chips — one click fills in the default model. An empty model list does not mean it will not work: some servers do not implement /models, so just type the model name. Outbound HTTPS verifies certificates by default (JD fetching and resume rewrite use the same policy): if the system certificate store cannot be loaded, the request is refused with a "fix the store (certmgr.msc)" message instead of silently skipping verification — your API key never travels over an unverified connection. The explicit opt-out is JOBWS_HTTP_TLS=insecure (not recommended)
  • Data and privacy: export everything as a zip, snapshot backup to the system user directory, one-click snapshot restore (rehearse first, then restore), diagnostics package export (version / platform / self-check summary / log tail — no workspace data, no credentials), open the data directory, no-telemetry statement
  • Due reminders: on/off switch + "remind N days ahead" (3 / 5 / 7); notifications dedupe per item per day, clicking one lands on that tracker row (full wording under Progress)
  • The settings page is searchable (including @modified to show only changed items) with per-item reset; changed items carry a mark
  • Export as Obsidian notes (CLI): python tools/jobws.py export --obsidian <dir> — one directory per CSV and one Markdown note per row, with all original columns in frontmatter (so Obsidian Bases / Dataview can filter and sort), question-bank notes carry spaced-repetition card syntax; output is timestamped, never overwrites a previous export, and never touches the workspace (a snapshot, not a sync). With --notes, the Markdown under 03_面试准备 / 04_知识库 / 00_事实库 is projected into notes as well (directory layout kept, full reads, no truncation, body copied as-is), so your phone holds the full material besides the flashcards; 训练卡 is not projected again (those cards already appear in the bank); hidden files (drafts, atomic-write temp names) are skipped by design and not listed, while files that fail to read or exceed 2 MiB are skipped and listed in the export's README; the output directory must live outside the workspace (pointing it inside is refused outright). Updating your phone vault: add --sync-to <vault dir> to mirror the new snapshot into a fixed Obsidian vault — the whitelisted entries (the eight table directories / README.md / jobws.base / the material directories) follow managed semantics (they get overwritten; rows deleted in the source disappear here too — deletions require --yes or the command refuses and leaves the vault untouched); everything outside the whitelist and the vault's .obsidian/ stays byte-identical; and notes that differ only by spaced-repetition annotations (<!--SR:…-->) or whitespace (blank lines / trailing spaces) are not overwritten — the annotations are your phone-side review progress and overwriting them would reset it — only real body changes update a note (that note's card progress resets). There is no force-overwrite switch: to realign a file, delete it in the vault and re-run (it comes back as a new file). Every run prints the new/updated/deleted plan before executing, and --dry-run stops after the plan; after a version upgrade, run --dry-run first (if the rendering template changed, the whole vault updates and all card progress resets). The full update order when copying by hand: ① copy the phone vault back to the computer, over the computer's vault directory (this brings the progress home) → ② run the sync → ③ copy the vault back to the phone; with a two-way cloud-sync folder the round trip happens automatically
  • No API key yet?: while no key is stored, the page shows a sign-up entry for a recommended provider, plus a button that fills in that provider's Base URL for you (the preset lives in one place in the source). The entry is labelled on screen as a referral link — signing up through it credits the project author; your pricing is unaffected, and clicking it only opens a web page (no data leaves the app). The entry currently points to OrcaRouter.

By default the AI judgement in this workbench is done by your AI CLI (CodeBuddy and friends); the provider is an optional BYOK enhancement (used for resume import and AI rewrite).

docs.title: Optional: read-only email fetch
docs.text:
If your mail provider supports IMAP, the workbench can pull recent recruiting emails so you do not have to copy-paste each one. Configure it under Settings → Read-only mailbox fetch (optional) — 「邮箱只读拉取」in the Chinese UI (the field takes your IMAP authorization code, not your web login password; most providers require you to enable IMAP in the web mail settings first).

Which providers are supported: the top of the card is a provider dropdown — QQ Mail / Foxmail, NetEase 163, NetEase 126, yeah.net, Gmail, Outlook / Hotmail, Alibaba Cloud Mail, Sina Mail, Sohu Mail, plus Other (enter manually). Picking one fills in the server and port — once you edit those fields yourself, nothing overwrites them again; you can also leave the server blank and let the domain decide. Each provider carries its own inline guidance (where to enable IMAP in the web client, how to obtain the app password / authorization code). 163 / 126 / yeah.net have one extra hard requirement — the client must declare its identity (IMAP ID) before opening a folder — and this workbench does that for you automatically. Outlook / Hotmail personal accounts are not supported yet: Microsoft retired basic authentication on 2024-09-16 and third-party clients must use OAuth2, while this workbench only supports username + app password, so the UI says exactly that instead of offering a field you can fill in and never connect (see the OAuth2 + IMAP feasibility study). After a successful test you can press Load available folders to get candidates (read-only LIST, one connection per click): click one to fill it in, or keep typing your own.

How it works, and what it will not do:

  • Read-only: the connection uses SELECT (readonly) and BODY.PEEK — it never sends, marks as read, moves, or deletes anything.
  • Connected only when you click: the mailbox is contacted exactly when you press Fetch from mailbox (「从邮箱拉取」) — there is no background timer, polling, or keep-alive.
  • Credentials go to the system credential store by default: the desktop build writes the app password to Windows Credential Manager, and <workspace>/config/imap.json keeps only a reference; values are masked in the UI and in error messages, and are excluded from export / backup zips. The source / CLI form (or an explicit JOBWS_CREDENTIAL_STORE=plaintext) is a plaintext fallback: the app password then lives in <workspace>/config/imap.json, readable by any process that can read your user directory — treat the workspace as sensitive and keep it out of synced folders or public shares. When the desktop build reads an old plaintext value it migrates it into Credential Manager; if that write fails the plaintext stays untouched (your password is never lost). After moving to a new machine, switching Windows accounts, or copying the workspace elsewhere, that reference cannot be resolved — the app tells you to save it again instead of pretending nothing was configured. When you want to forget the secret, the settings card can clear it for you — the entry in the system store and the reference in the config file are removed together (you will need to enter it again to use it).
  • Dry-run by default: fetching only lists emails; nothing is written to the tracker until you confirm a suggestion item by item.
  • TLS certificate verification is on by default: the connection verifies the mail server's certificate against your system trust store. On machines whose Windows certificate store is corrupted, create_default_context() fails and the connection is refused (your authorization code must not travel over an unverified connection). If you understand the risk — the connection can then be intercepted by a man-in-the-middle — you can explicitly set the environment variable JOBWS_IMAP_TLS=insecure to skip verification.

Typical flow: Tracker → Fetch from mailbox → pick a time window (last 7 / 30 / 90 days) → filter by keyword locally → click an email → review the parsed suggestion → confirm what to write back. All three body wordings are labelled in the UI: the fetch list shows the original (quotes and signature kept, truncated past 140 characters); opening one pre-fills the full original (capped at 4000 characters server-side, marked "Truncated" when it hits the cap); and the snippet on a ✨ suggestion card is an excerpt (quotes and signature already removed, used for parsing only). They differ on purpose — it is not lost data. If the email belongs to an application you have not recorded yet, the empty state offers a create-record form (the stage defaults to what the email implies).

Each fetched email has three destinations: clicking the message body goes through parse → suggestion → confirm to update an application's stage; clicking ✨ expands parse suggestions in place (six kinds: time / deadline / link validity / meeting link / suggested stage / matched record — each with its source snippet and confidence, written only after you confirm; invitations are read from the calendar attachment first, which beats regex on the body); clicking the small "＋" icon on the right records the email's metadata into the email ledger (subject / sender / date / Message-ID) — later, add a tag and a link under Progress → Emails instead of typing it all again.

Values marked "Needs check" (no year in the text, relative dates like "tomorrow" or "this Friday") require ticking "I've checked the value" before writing; meeting-link cards can be copied or opened directly, and once recorded the link stays openable/copyable under Progress → Emails. Parse suggestions live inside Fetch from mailbox — a manually pasted body has no calendar attachment and keeps using the original Paste email dialog. With a BYOK provider configured (Settings → Provider), an optional AI boost row appears at the bottom: enter a model name and run it manually — same suggestion flow, always labelled "AI", still confirmed by you. AI only suggests; it never writes.

Sentences like "please finish the online assessment before the 25th" become a deadline fact — the fifth kind. The card carries the task it belongs to ("Finish the online assessment") and the date; confirming it writes both the tracker's next-action date and its next-action text. Those are exactly the fields the due reminder reads (the dashboard's upcoming list and the system notification), so the countdown appears on its own — no extra setting. Relative dates cover today / tomorrow / the day after / "this X" and "next X" (both Monday-based weeks); a date that has already passed is the overdue signal itself and stays marked "Needs check". Duration phrasings ("within N days / N working days / the link is valid for N hours") are counted from the day the email was sent — a mail received three days ago saying "within 3 days" is already overdue today, not "3 days out"; working days skip weekends but not public holidays; "the link … is valid" is its own kind, separate from the thing you must finish.

What the due reminder covers in full (desktop): Settings lets you pick how many days ahead to remind (3 / 5 / 7, default 3). A notification fires when any of these is true: overdue (both "deadline passed and never applied" and "the next action date passed", sorted by how long ago), a to-do within the lead time (today's items and "N days left" items read differently in the body), or a talk within 7 days. Deduplication is per item, once a day — one you were already told about stays quiet, but one that appears later the same day still fires. Clicking the notification opens the tracker with that row expanded. A persistent reminder bar sits at the top of the content area (same endpoint, same switch): opening the app shows "N overdue / N to-dos within the lead time / N talks", each linking to the page that handles it — when nothing is due it renders nothing at all. Turning the switch off stops both the notification and the bar; closing the window stops everything — no background service, no tray icon.

docs.title: IV. Putting the AI to work: the jwb-jd / jwb-apply workflows
Plugging into another AI host (MCP, optional)
docs.text:
The workbench also ships an MCP server, so hosts that speak MCP (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, …) can read your tracker, job pool and dashboard — and write only after you confirm (the AI shows you a diff first, then writes with a one-shot token).

  • Install and per-host config shapes: docs/mcp-integration.md (the config key differs per host — do not copy blindly).
  • What each of the four entries (CLI / AI host / editor plugin / desktop UI) can do: docs/four-ends.md.

The web UI is for looking and recording; judgement belongs to the AI. Talk to it in natural language inside CodeBuddy:

docs.title: Parse a role (jwb-jd workflow)
docs.text:
Paste the JD, or say "parse this JD". The AI will:

  1. Save the JD text under personal/01_岗位池/<company>_<role>/
  2. Run the hard eligibility filter (degree → major → cohort → English → city) against personal/AGENTS.md
  3. If it passes, score four dimensions (technical 30 / experience 25 / direction 30 / growth 15) and cross-check against your fact cards
  4. Verify the total and output a tier (75–100 apply strongly / 60–74 apply / 45–59 think about it / 30–44 likely skip / 0–29 do not apply)

Failing a hard requirement stops everything — no score, no materials. For example a role with a hard language requirement is blocked by your own language red line.

docs.title: Generate an application package (jwb-apply workflow)
docs.text: Say "generate an application package for role XX". The AI will: pick the resume version for that direction → adjust four places as needed (project facts are never touched) → generate the PDF → run the ATS check (page count / text layer / key facts) → archive under 05_投递追踪/applications/ → write to the tracker → list the changes and hand them to you to confirm before committing to git.

docs.title: Update progress (jwb-track)
docs.text: After an interview, say "move XX to first round", or just use the dropdown in the tracker.

docs.title: Rebuild the resume PDF after edits (jwb-resume workflow)
docs.text:
Say "rebuild the resume PDF", or from the command line:

python tools/jobws.py resume --workspace personal --version hvac

docs.title: V. CLI quick reference (when you would rather not use the web UI)
docs.text:
Run every command from the repo root. --workspace personal can be omitted (it is the default).

# Tracker
python tools/jobws.py track list                        # every record
python tools/jobws.py track list --due-within 7         # due within 7 days
python tools/jobws.py track list --stage 笔试           # filter by stage
python tools/jobws.py track add --company "某公司" --role "岗位" --direction hvac --batch 正式批 ...
python tools/jobws.py track update --id A001 --stage 一面 --next "准备口述" --next-date 2026-09-10
python tools/jobws.py track history --id A001           # change timeline
python tools/jobws.py track import --file 待导入.csv --dry-run   # bulk CSV import (preview diff only)
python tools/jobws.py track import --file 待导入.csv             # write, once the preview is clean
python tools/jobws.py track interview add --app A001 --round 一面 --questions "..."   # interview record
python tools/jobws.py track contact add --name "张工" --app A001   # recruiter contact
python tools/jobws.py track offer add --company "某公司" --monthly "..."  # offer facts
python tools/jobws.py track mail add --subject "Interview invite (round 1)" --app A001 --tag 邀约  # email ledger
python tools/jobws.py track mail list --app A001        # emails linked to one application
python tools/jobws.py track check                       # schema self-check (quarantines broken files)

# Application funnel report (Markdown, incl. cycle review and failure clustering)
python tools/jobws.py report --stdout

# Resume PDF + ATS check
python tools/jobws.py resume --workspace personal            # all versions
python tools/jobws.py resume --version hvac                  # one version
python tools/jobws.py resume render --workspace personal     # data-driven standard layout
python tools/jobws.py resume render --template std_compact --resume-accent 酒红   # layout + accent color

# JD parsed-card score validation
python tools/jobws.py jd "personal/01_岗位池/<dir>/解析卡.md" --domain hvac-cooling --direction hvac
python tools/jobws.py jd --gap --resume hvac "personal/01_岗位池/<dir>/解析卡.md"   # JD↔resume gaps

The stage names above (笔试, 一面, …) are the actual values written into your data files, which is why they appear in Chinese. They are validated against a fixed list (STAGES in jobws_core.tracker), so they cannot simply be renamed to English.

docs.title: VI. Where your data lives, and how to back it up
docs.text:
All data is plain text, under personal/:

Directory Contents 00_事实库/ Project/internship fact cards — the single source of truth 01_岗位池/ One directory per role: the JD text + parsed card 02_简历工坊/ Resume markdown + HTML templates + generated PDFs + photo 03_面试准备/ Self-intro, project pitches, behavioural stories, retros (the question bank lives in 05_投递追踪/questions.csv below) 04_知识库/ Knowledge dictionaries — built by you on demand (the skeleton ships a README only) 05_投递追踪/ Eight tables: tracker.csv (applications) + history.csv (change timeline) + interviews / contacts / offers / talks / mails / questions.csv AGENTS.md Your profile: hard-requirement facts, honesty red lines

Backup (important): all of personal/ is gitignored — git does not track your data, and a clone of the repo carries none of it. The two supported ways to back up:

  1. Settings → "Back up now": snapshot to the system user directory (outside the workspace; one click; recommended)
  2. Settings → "Export everything as zip": a complete workspace you can take anywhere

⚠️ Sharing the repository itself is safe — personal/ is not in it. Never send the personal/ directory to anyone (it holds your name, photo and contact details).

docs.title: localhost:5173 is blank / will not connect
docs.text:
Work through these in order:

  1. Is the service alive? Restart with cd web && .\start.ps1 (it clears the ports for you). Vite is a foreground process — if the terminal that started it is closed, the service is gone. This is by far the most common cause
  2. Is the browser caching old JS? Force a reload with Ctrl + F5
  3. Still blank? The app now has an ErrorBoundary, so a crash shows an error message instead of a blank page. Open the Console (F12) and send me the error

docs.title: The startup script errors
docs.text:
start.ps1 locates the repo root with three fallbacks (argument → script location → walking up for AGENTS.md). If it says it cannot locate the repo root, run it from inside the repo, or pass the path explicitly:

.\start.ps1 -RepoRoot <repo dir>

docs.title: npm does nothing
docs.text: On Windows you must start the frontend manually with npm.cmd run dev. A plain npm run dev can fail silently depending on how it is invoked (no error, and nothing listens on the port).

docs.title: The port is taken
docs.text:
start.ps1 frees 8765/5173 automatically. To do it by hand:

Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8765 -State Listen | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force }

docs.title: A job card in the UI has no score
docs.text: A score needs two things: the 解析卡.md must exist and its four dimensions must add up to a consistent total (validated by the jd_score rules). If you hand-edited a parsed card and broke the format, the UI treats it as "not scored". Run python tools/jobws.py jd <path to parsed card> to see exactly what does not add up.

docs.title: CSV opens as gibberish in Excel
docs.text: It should not — files are written with a UTF-8 BOM (utf-8-sig). If it really is garbled, some other tool rewrote the encoding; tell me and I will fix it.

docs.title: Double-clicking the exe does nothing
docs.text:
With console=True, a black window that flashes past means it failed at startup. Causes and what to do:

  1. Port taken → the exe now prints a clear message and keeps the window open (unless your antivirus interferes). First check who holds the port: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8765 -State Listen
  2. A freshly built exe being empty is expected — see "Option 3" above (the exe is a clean distribution; it does not read the repo-root data)

docs.title: The page title says "Vite + React + TS"
docs.text: That is a stale artifact from an older build or a cached bundle. Force-reload with Ctrl+F5; if it persists, rebuild the frontend (cd web/frontend && npm.cmd run build) and restart the backend. The new correct title is "Job Workbench" (the window title follows the interface language — 求职工作台 in Chinese).

docs.title: .ps1 scripts throw ParserError / mojibake
docs.text: A .ps1 containing Chinese must be saved as UTF-8 with BOM. Save it without the BOM and Windows PowerShell 5.1 decodes it as GBK, producing syntax errors. Both scripts (start.ps1, build_backend_exe.ps1) ship with a BOM — do not strip it if you edit them.

docs.title: VIII. Where to go next in the docs
docs.text: What you want Where to look Overall architecture (three-layer split, domain profiles) docs/specs/2026-08-30-general-workbench-design.md Web layer design (API contracts, concurrency, security) docs/specs/2026-08-30-web-prototype-design.md AI workflow definitions The nine SKILL.md files under skills/ (five job-hunting + one setup/extension + three maintainer-facing; each keeps the main file lean and puts details in its own references/. tools/jobws.py skills install distributes all three asset types — skills, commands, subagents) Support & compatibility docs/support-and-compatibility.md (what counts as a stable release, what is supported, why upgrades never require converting data) Key decisions (why it is built this way) the short records under docs/decisions/ (human-confirmed writes, single release node, data compatibility, hooks off by default) Documentation index docs/README.md

docs.title: Appearance: themes and typefaces
docs.text:
The "Appearance" card on the Settings page (device-level preference — this machine only, not exported with the workspace):

  • Themes: dark by default, plus a light theme and 8 open-source skins (Catppuccin Mocha·Latte / Nord / Tokyo Night / Rosé Pine + Dawn / Gruvbox / Everforest) and a "System" option; "Custom theme…" tweaks key colors with live contrast feedback and saves into the list; JSON and tweakcn / shadcn CSS can be imported.
  • Typefaces: 12 UI options (Inter by default; Geist, IBM Plex Sans, Manrope, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Figtree, Outfit, Public Sans, Source Sans 3, Work Sans, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next; plus the system stack and serif) and a separate monospace slot with 6 options (Maple Mono by default; JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Geist Mono, IBM Plex Mono, Source Code Pro) for code / IDs / dates, and a dedicated numerals slot (Geist Mono by default; JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, or "follow the UI typeface") for values — all bundled locally under OFL-1.1, Latin subsets only, so CJK text falls back to the system stack. Interface size is a continuous slider (80%–150%, 5% steps). Terminal fonts live in your terminal app — jobws prefs doctor prints a recommended list (Maple Mono / JetBrains Mono / Sarasa Gothic).
  • Layering: themes / typefaces are device-level (localStorage); jobws prefs (theme / font / resume_style) is workspace-level material preference for the CLI, skills and exports.

Theme changes are gated by jobws lint themes (parity / contrast / elevation ladder) — all 10 built-in themes satisfy 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large text and graphics.
